infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Loc8 uses your location to show your crew where you are — even with no signal. It's shared only with your crew, end-to-end encrypted.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Loc8 keeps you findable to your crew in the background during an active session. Shared only with your crew.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Loc8 uses the compass to point the arrow toward your friends.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Loc8 uses Bluetooth to find your crew directly, phone-to-phone, when there's no internet.
